gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.167: As the werewolf's beast, right-click a body or a severed limb to tear into it. Every bite feeds you and closes your wounds. Sneak and right-click to carry it instead.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.168: Nothing dead lies long. Wolves, bears and big cats eat severed limbs and bodies, vultures circle overhead before snatching one up, and the downed are eaten alive, limbs first, unless someone stands guard over them.
